title: 2026 AMC 8 Problem 5
statement: Casey went on a road trip that covered \(100\) miles, stopping only for a lunch break along the way. The trip took \(3\) hours in total and her average speed while driving was \(40\) miles per hour. In minutes, how long was the lunch break?

solutions.text: Driving \(100\) miles at \(40\) miles per hour takes \(\frac{100}{40}=2.5\) hours. The whole trip took \(3\) hours, so the lunch break lasted \(0.5\) hours, which is \(30\) minutes.
hints: Find the driving time from distance and speed
The lunch break is the total time minus the driving time
